changelog.category: Search Page UI Redesign & 3-Dot Mobile Accessibility (v1.8.2)
items: Redesigned search row items with clean 3-dot vertical ellipsis buttons (⋮) pinned safely on the right.
Set max-width constraints on track title and artist text containers to prevent clipping of option buttons.
Added circular avatar Artist card section at top of search results.
Redesigned search bar with 28px rounded pill styling and dark #212121 theme.
Updated filter chips with checkmark icon and active dark grey styling.
Preserved 100% of music streaming and backend logic.
Bumped service worker cache version to v119.
